audit: 2026-09-17 scheduled remote agent, third fire of the day: one 43 question batch across all four modules, published as data/batches/sched_multi_topic_2026-09-17_c.json. Split 13 Medicine, 11 Psychiatry, 10 Obstetrics and Gynaecology and 9 Paediatrics; tier mix 5 L3, 36 L4 and 2 L5 with no L1 and no L2, taking the bank to 6935. Cell selection: the live matrix before this fire read all four modules level at 1723 with L2 at 422, 407, 353 and 380 respectively. Read literally, with L2 inside the denominator, every L3 and L4 cell shows a permanent double digit deficit because the legacy L2 stock cannot be reduced by generating, and the L3 and L4 deficits sit within 0.5 points of each other in every module, so the near tie rule fires on every question and the signal is degenerate. Measured over the L3 to L5 tiers only, which is the achievable shape, the proportions were Paediatrics 49.81/43.34/6.86, Obstetrics 49.85/43.37/6.78, Psychiatry 49.56/44.04/6.40 and Medicine 49.96/43.41/6.63: L3 is at target within 0.4 points everywhere, L4 is the deficient tier at 1.0 to 1.7 points below the 45 per cent ideal, and L5 is in surplus by 1.4 to 1.9 points. The batch was therefore weighted heavily to L4, with L5 held at 2 rather than zero to hold the standing share, consistent with the previous fire. DUPLICATE FINDING, the substantive result of this run: the batch was drafted at 50 and cut to 43 because 27 of the 50 drafted questions duplicated existing bank content while passing scripts/dupe_gate.py cleanly. The gate compares subtopic_detail concatenated with the correct option text and flags at 0.80 combined, or 0.85 answer similarity with detail at or above 0.62. Two things defeat it at this bank size. First, many older entries carry terse label style subtopic_detail such as 'lithium and hypothyroidism' or 'severe cutaneous adverse reaction discrimination' while newer entries carry full sentences, so the detail component of the combined score is deflated and genuine repeats score 0.55 to 0.75 rather than above 0.80. Second, answer similarity alone is not checked unless detail similarity is also high, so a question asking the same exam point in different words passes. Screening each drafted question on answer similarity alone against the same topic found 21 matches at or above 0.60, among them allopurinol DRESS, lithium induced hypothyroidism, hypnotic deprescribing, adenomyosis treated with the levonorgestrel intrauterine system, lamotrigine clearance in pregnancy, intravenous iron in pregnancy, shunt malfunction, precocious puberty imaging, depersonalisation after cannabis and the pleural albumin gradient, each of which repeats an existing question. Two full rounds of replacement were run, choosing new clusters by pre screening candidate detail and answer pairs against the bank before writing, and each round surfaced further near duplicates, which is the expected behaviour of a bank that has saturated the common Year 4 curriculum at 1723 questions per module. The 43 published questions are those clearing both axes, with combined below 0.62 and answer similarity below 0.62 against every existing question in the same topic. RECOMMENDATION for the maintainer: tighten scripts/dupe_gate.py by adding an answer only rule at about 0.62 independent of detail similarity, and normalise the older terse subtopic_detail entries, otherwise routine fires will continue to add duplicates that the gate reports as clear. Clusters published: Paediatrics took viral triggered wheeze versus asthma, nephrotic syndrome misread as allergy, von Willebrand disease in an adolescent, childhood leukaemia versus immune thrombocytopenia, safe infant sleep, juvenile myoclonic epilepsy, spinal muscular atrophy, neonatal hypoglycaemia and adolescent confidentiality; Obstetrics took gestational thrombocytopenia, middle cerebral artery Doppler in alloimmunisation, molar pregnancy surveillance, primary genital herpes near term, Sheehan syndrome, lactational mastitis, asthma self reduction in pregnancy, thyroxine dose in early pregnancy, instrumental birth in theatre and menopausal hormone therapy for osteopenia; Psychiatry took sleep terrors, prescribed opioid tapering, refeeding versus underfeeding in anorexia nervosa, clozapine gastrointestinal hypomotility, psychogenic non epileptic seizures, antipsychotic continuation in pregnancy, narcolepsy with cataplexy, rapid eye movement sleep behaviour disorder, dissociative amnesia, intermittent explosive disorder and QT prolongation with citalopram; Medicine took tumour lysis prophylaxis, hypertriglyceridaemic pancreatitis, alcoholic ketoacidosis, hepatitis B reactivation before rituximab, coeliac non response, exertional syncope, incidental pulmonary nodule, amiodarone induced thyrotoxicosis, iron deficiency anaemia workup, breast triple assessment, abdominal aortic aneurysm surveillance, prolactin elevation on risperidone and deprescribing in frailty.
